summary.text: Formation path Gu Immortals build Gu formations on dao marks. Grandmasters use marks inside immortal materials; great grandmasters can use the natural dao marks of heaven and earth directly.

claims.text: After setting a Lang Ya transportation Gu formation, Fang Yuan notes that a formation path Gu Immortal at great grandmaster attainment level can use the dao marks of heaven and earth to arrange the formation. The formation he places is similar in relying on environmental marks, and it uses an immemorial corpse’s water path dao marks as its foundation.
General dao marks and attainment levels are covered on dao marks and attainment.

Chi Shang confirms Fang Yuan’s reading: formation path great grandmasters can use the natural dao marks of the surroundings and need fewer Gu worms. In places with abundant natural dao marks, mortal Gu alone can form an immortal Gu formation. At grandmaster level, cultivators can only use dao marks inside Gu materials and immortal materials; those materials are destroyed after long use. Great grandmasters go one step further and also use surrounding dao marks according to the environment. Chi Shang also states that the essence of formation path is to create environments.
A formation path great grandmaster can directly use the natural dao marks in the world to set up formations, and often needs only some mortal Gu to set up immortal Gu formations in specific areas.

With formation path grandmaster attainment, Fang Yuan can use the dao marks in immortal materials to set up immortal formations, which is how he builds a costly rank eight year essence pool as an immortal Gu formation.
